name: Mirrortech DEMO NAV Share
assumptions: DEMO ONLY: the separately supplied NAV cashier addendum, not the base BUIDL document, authorizes these economics.
NAV, distinct subscription/redemption fees and cap are read from the explicit DEMO addendum. No economic value in this config overrides that evidence.
The AMM fee and tick spacing are deployment settings bound into the compiled policy, not inferred terms of the base agreement.
Only six-decimal non-rebasing, non-fee-on-transfer mockUSD is supported. Redemption is limited by prefunded available reserves.
Issuer authorization, offering compliance, subscription acceptance, funding confirmation, redemption authorization, KYC, AML and World ID are operator/gateway attestations.
Actual cashier subscriptions additionally settle mockUSD on chain; custodial issuance remains privileged and is not automatically reserve-backed.
The NAV band is not a theorem about all arbitrage or LP losses. Transaction ordering, gas, eligibility, NAV and reserve assumptions remain material.
